# Crosshair

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Crosshair, Crosshair+

## What it does

Crosshair replaces Minecraft's default crosshair with a custom-drawn one, giving you more control over how the center of your screen looks. Pick between a circular reticle or a CS2-style four-line cross, and tune the size, color, and animation to taste.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/crosshair). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
